title: Changing the lead on the board sends the same notifications as today
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide. Narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher.
  3. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  4. At least 3 technicians are eligible at this location (e.g. "Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz"). A staff member is eligible when Clockable is on, the staff record is Active, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location. To add one:
    • Settings > Staff > add a staff member, enter a first and last name (e.g. "Dana Ortiz") and an email.
    • Pick a role that is not Office or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), turn Clockable on, keep the record Active, enrol the staff member at this location, then Save.
  5. Esther Howard, Ralph Edwards and Dana Ortiz can sign in (each staff record has an email and an accepted invite).
  6. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  7. Create the work order: Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the case customer (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") and its asset > create it, and write down its number (e.g. "S1-702").
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to "Esther Howard".
    • On the Lines tab click New Line, enter a name (e.g. "Brake inspection") and labor hours (e.g. 2.0), and save the line.
    • Click the line's Approve (check) button so the work order status reads Approved.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order page and change Lead Technician from Esther Howard to Ralph Edwards there.
  2. In a second browser, sign in as Esther Howard and then as Ralph Edwards, and write down any notification each of them received for this change (notification bell, email, or none).
  3. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; in the design its button tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Type the case customer's name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co") in Search.
  5. In the first browser, drag the card from Ralph Edwards' column into Dana Ortiz's column.
  6. If a "Clear …'s scheduled shifts?" prompt opens, click Keep shifts.
  7. In the second browser, sign in as Ralph Edwards and then as Dana Ortiz and write down any notification each received.
  8. Repeat steps 3 to 7 in Tech View with the row's More actions > Reassign lead technician, moving it back to Esther Howard.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A lead change made in Board View or Tech View produces exactly the same notifications as a lead change made on the work order page (step 2 compared with steps 6 and 8). The product owner records that no notification is sent on a lead change today, so none is expected in either place.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R6, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313 DR-46 and FF-4 (no notification is sent on a lead change today, S4-R6 keeps it that way), Sasha Grosman 24 Sep 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R6: “Preserve existing work order detail-page notification behavior when the lead technician changes.”
